description: 국토교통부_정류장 현황 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 전국 버스 정류장 정보를 제공하는 지표입니다. 시도, 시군구, 읍면동별 정류장 정보로 구분되며 정류장 명칭, ARS번호 등이 제공됩니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 교통카드, 정류장, 대중교통, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2024-07-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
